topic: The psychological impact of 'money scripts' on spending habits
hook: Do your childhood money habits control you?

plan_reasons.angle: testing general trends posts (25% of posts until there is data)

caption:
Your childhood experiences shape your current money habits more than you might realize. Identifying these unconscious beliefs helps you make intentional choices rather than reacting out of habit. Understanding why you spend the way you do is a key part of financial health. What is one money belief you remember hearing growing up? Save this for later and share it with someone who needs it. #FinancialHealth #MoneyMindset #BudgetingTips #PersonalFinance #MoneyHabits #FinancialLiteracy #RXT
